question: Where is Lincoln University College located?
answer: Lincoln University College’s main campus is at Wisma Lincoln, No. 12-18, Jalan SS 6/12, 47301 Petaling Jaya, Selangor Darul Ehsan, Malaysia.

question: What is the phone number for the admissions office?
answer: You can contact the admissions office at Lincoln University College via +603-7806 3478 (Malaysia hotline).}

question: What are the office hours for the International Students Office?
answer: The International Students Office at Lincoln University College operates Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

question: How can I apply for an undergraduate programme?
answer: To apply for an undergraduate programme at Lincoln University College, submit your online application via the university website, attach required academic transcripts and passport copy, then await the official offer letter.

question: What are the tuition fees for undergraduate programmes?
answer: Tuition fees at Lincoln University College for undergraduate programmes vary depending on the course and student nationality; as a rough guide, fees start from approximately RM 10,000 to RM 25,000 per year.

question: Are scholarships available for international students?
answer: Yes – Lincoln University College offers partial scholarships for eligible international students. Please contact the admissions office for details on eligibility and amounts.

question: Which bus or train stops near the campus?
answer: Public transportation is available near the Lincoln University College main campus — the campus is walking-distance from a bus stop and a nearby LRT station.

question: What is the student hostel monthly rate?
answer: At Lincoln University College, the hostel accommodation rates for LUC students include: Single Room (Type A) at approx RM 700 per month, Twin‐sharing (Type B) at approx RM 500 per month.

question: How many semesters are there in a year for most programmes?
answer: For most programmes at Lincoln University College, there are 3 semesters per year (except for Nursing which has 2 semesters).

question: How do I pay my international tuition fee?
answer: International students may pay tuition fees via bank telegraphic transfer (TT) to the designated account of ASIA PACIFIC HIGHER LEARNING SDN BHD (Lincoln University College) – details specified in your offer letter.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: Documents required include academic transcripts, passport copy, recent photos, and any other supporting certificates – as specified in your offer letter from Lincoln University College.

question: When are the intake sessions for programmes?
answer: Lincoln University College offers multiple intakes each year – for instance January, May and September intakes are available.

question: Is my programme approved by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA)?
answer: Yes – all programmes at Lincoln University College are approved by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) / Malaysian Qualifications Register (MQR).

question: Where do I go to reset my password for the student portal?
answer: To reset your password, go to the 'Forgot Password?' link on the Lincoln University College student portal login page and follow the instructions sent to your registered email address.

question: How do I check my exam results?
answer: You can view your exam results via the ‘Examination Unit’ section on the Lincoln University College portal or you may contact examination@lincoln.edu.my for assistance.

question: Where can I find my class schedule?
answer: Your personalized class schedule is available in the 'Schedule' section of the Lincoln University College student app/portal – it shows your upcoming classes, timings and venues.

question: How do I apply for a student visa as an international student?
answer: Once you have your offer letter from Lincoln University College, student visa application via the Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) is required – pay the visa processing fee and submit required documentation.

question: Can I pay my second‐year fees by installment?
answer: Yes – at Lincoln University College international students may pay second-year fees by semester instalments if they meet criteria like CGPA ≥ 2.0, clean account record and at least 90% attendance.

question: What happens if a programme is discontinued due to insufficient students?
answer: If a programme at Lincoln University College is cancelled due to low enrolment, students will be informed and alternative arrangements will be offered. (Students are advised to check the official policy)

question: How do I contact the Student Affairs Department?
answer: You can email the Student Affairs Department of Lincoln University College at inso@lincoln.edu.my or iam@lincoln.edu.my.
